title: The Gravity-Defying Future of Manufacturing | Schendy Kernizan | TED
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】製造業的反重力未來|申迪·克尼贊 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: I’m Schendy Kernizan.
cues.en: I’m Schendy Kernizan.
cues.zh: 我是申迪·克尼贊。

cues.text: I'm creating a new way of manufacturing objects.
cues.en: I'm creating a new way of manufacturing objects.
cues.zh: 我正在創造一種製造物體的新方法。

cues.text: I'm part of a company called Rapid Liquid Print that is rethinking how products are made.
cues.en: I'm part of a company called Rapid Liquid Print that is rethinking how products are made.
cues.zh: 我所在的公司名為 Rapid Liquid Print，公司正在重新思考產品的製造方式。

cues.text: 3D printing -- for those who are not familiar with it -- has been a technology
cues.en: 3D printing -- for those who are not familiar with it -- has been a technology
cues.zh: 對於那些不熟悉 3D 列印的人來說，3D 列印已經成為一項技術

cues.text: that's really taken off in the past 30 years.
cues.en: that's really taken off in the past 30 years.
cues.zh: 在過去的 30 年裡，這確實取得了快速發展。

cues.text: Traditional manufacturing was using a method that's just been so outdated,
cues.en: Traditional manufacturing was using a method that's just been so outdated,
cues.zh: 傳統製造使用的方法已經過時了，

cues.text: not digitized.
cues.en: not digitized.
cues.zh: 沒有數位化。

cues.text: 3D printing became kind of the new way of making that.
cues.en: 3D printing became kind of the new way of making that.
cues.zh: 3D 列印成為了一種新的製造方式。

cues.text: People said, "Oh, this is going to replace traditional manufacturing."
cues.en: People said, "Oh, this is going to replace traditional manufacturing."
cues.zh: 人們說，“哦，這將取代傳統製造業。”

cues.text: But the issue is that you need to build on a platform.
cues.en: But the issue is that you need to build on a platform.
cues.zh: 但問題是你需要在一個平臺上建置。

cues.text: So you always need a surface that you're starting with in order to create an object.
cues.en: So you always need a surface that you're starting with in order to create an object.
cues.zh: 因此，您始終需要一個表面來建立物件。

cues.text: And the more complex that geometry becomes, gravity starts to become a limitation of what you can make.
cues.en: And the more complex that geometry becomes, gravity starts to become a limitation of what you can make.
cues.zh: 幾何形狀變得越複雜，重力就開始限制你的製作能力。

cues.text: And in order to circumvent that, you need to actually create supports -- and then you need to remove those supports.
cues.en: And in order to circumvent that, you need to actually create supports -- and then you need to remove those supports.
cues.zh: 為了避免這種情況，您需要實際建立支撐 - 然後需要刪除這些支撐。

cues.text: So it's really kind of a manual effort of cleaning those pieces that are then discarded.
cues.en: So it's really kind of a manual effort of cleaning those pieces that are then discarded.
cues.zh: 因此，這實際上是一種手動清理那些然後被丟棄的碎片的工作。

cues.text: And it's quite wasteful.
cues.en: And it's quite wasteful.
cues.zh: 而且非常浪費。

cues.text: So 3D printing has almost become kind of this system
cues.en: So 3D printing has almost become kind of this system
cues.zh: 所以3D列印幾乎已經成為這個系統的一種

cues.text: that's great for prototyping, but hasn't really created that bridge from prototyping to production.
cues.en: that's great for prototyping, but hasn't really created that bridge from prototyping to production.
cues.zh: 這對於原型設計來說非常有用，但並沒有真正建立從原型設計到生產的橋樑。

cues.text: We solved that by printing inside of this gel that holds the shape that you're drawing.
cues.en: We solved that by printing inside of this gel that holds the shape that you're drawing.
cues.zh: 我們透過在凝膠內部進行列印來解決這個問題，該凝膠可以保持您正在繪製的形狀。

cues.text: You're able to eliminate gravity.
cues.en: You're able to eliminate gravity.
cues.zh: 你能夠消除重力。

cues.text: Think of the ability of, you know -- if I have an idea in my mind, and I have a pencil,
cues.en: Think of the ability of, you know -- if I have an idea in my mind, and I have a pencil,
cues.zh: 想想我的能力，你知道的——如果我腦子裡有一個想法，而我有一支鉛筆，

cues.text: can I draw it in space and then have that shape there?
cues.en: can I draw it in space and then have that shape there?
cues.zh: 我可以在太空中繪製它然後在那裡得到那個形狀嗎？

cues.text: So you go on the computer, you draw the geometry that you want, and that information gets sent to the printer.
cues.en: So you go on the computer, you draw the geometry that you want, and that information gets sent to the printer.
cues.zh: 因此，您可以在電腦上繪製所需的幾何圖形，然後將該資訊傳送到印表機。

cues.text: And as the machine is moving -- think of your arm moving that pencil around --
cues.en: And as the machine is moving -- think of your arm moving that pencil around --
cues.zh: 當機器移動時——想像一下你的手臂在移動鉛筆——

cues.text: the material is coming out of it, and the machine knows how fast or how slow it needs to go
cues.en: the material is coming out of it, and the machine knows how fast or how slow it needs to go
cues.zh: 材料從裡面出來，機器知道它需要多快或多慢

cues.text: and where it needs to be drawing it inside of the tank.
cues.en: and where it needs to be drawing it inside of the tank.
cues.zh: 以及需要將其拉入水箱內的位置。

cues.text: The gel is mostly water that’s been transformed into gelatin.
cues.en: The gel is mostly water that’s been transformed into gelatin.
cues.zh: 凝膠主要是已轉化為明膠的水。

cues.text: And think of hand sanitizer consistency where it can move, but it has structure to itself.
cues.en: And think of hand sanitizer consistency where it can move, but it has structure to itself.
cues.zh: 想想洗手液的一致性，它可以移動，但它有自己的結構。

cues.text: And the viscosity is strong enough where whatever you extrude inside of it doesn't just pull out the bottom.
cues.en: And the viscosity is strong enough where whatever you extrude inside of it doesn't just pull out the bottom.
cues.zh: 而且黏度夠強，無論你在裡面擠出什麼，都不會直接拉出底部。

cues.text: And when it's done, you just let it there until it fully cures.
cues.en: And when it's done, you just let it there until it fully cures.
cues.zh: 完成後，您只需將其放在那裡，直到完全治癒。

cues.text: You're literally doing calligraphy in space.
cues.en: You're literally doing calligraphy in space.
cues.zh: 你其實是在太空中寫書法。

cues.text: You're able to make parts faster.
cues.en: You're able to make parts faster.
cues.zh: 您能夠更快地製造零件。

cues.text: You can customize the colors that you want.
cues.en: You can customize the colors that you want.
cues.zh: 您可以自訂您想要的顏色。

cues.text: You can blend colors, create gradients of colors.
cues.en: You can blend colors, create gradients of colors.
cues.zh: 您可以混合顏色，建立顏色漸層。

cues.text: And instead of having this mold that you then need to discard or put away
cues.en: And instead of having this mold that you then need to discard or put away
cues.zh: 然後您不需要丟棄或收起這個模具

cues.text: because your design is different the next time that you build something,
cues.en: because your design is different the next time that you build something,
cues.zh: 因為下次建造東西時你的設計會有所不同，

cues.text: with this gel, it's reusable.
cues.en: with this gel, it's reusable.
cues.zh: 這種凝膠可以重複使用。

cues.text: So you can extract that part, you rinse it with water and you're reusing the gel to make more parts.
cues.en: So you can extract that part, you rinse it with water and you're reusing the gel to make more parts.
cues.zh: 所以你可以提取該部分，用水沖洗它，然後重複使用凝膠來製造更多的部分。

cues.text: So it's a reusable process and sustainable way of making things.
cues.en: So it's a reusable process and sustainable way of making things.
cues.zh: 因此，這是一種可重複使用的過程和可持續的製造方式。

cues.text: As human beings, anything I touch, even from your phone case, usually having some kind of flexibility and give to it
cues.en: As human beings, anything I touch, even from your phone case, usually having some kind of flexibility and give to it
cues.zh: 作為人類，我接觸到的任何東西，甚至是你的手機殼，通常都具有某種靈活性並給予它

cues.text: feels more relatable than having a hard surface that you're touching.
cues.en: feels more relatable than having a hard surface that you're touching.
cues.zh: 比觸控堅硬的表面更有關聯感。

cues.text: Early days, there was another research group at MIT
cues.en: Early days, there was another research group at MIT
cues.zh: 早期，麻省理工學院還有另一個研究小組

cues.text: that was doing a lot of prosthetics, orthotics.
cues.en: that was doing a lot of prosthetics, orthotics.
cues.zh: 那是做了很多義肢、矯正器。

cues.text: They saw our process and thought, "Hey, this could be actually beneficial for us."
cues.en: They saw our process and thought, "Hey, this could be actually beneficial for us."
cues.zh: 他們看到我們的流程並想：“嘿，這實際上對我們有益。”

cues.text: And that led us to talk to more clinicians out there, more people in that space.
cues.en: And that led us to talk to more clinicians out there, more people in that space.
cues.zh: 這促使我們與更多的臨床醫生、更多的該領域的人進行交談。

cues.text: People said customization would be really beneficial, but don’t have a way to do that easily.
cues.en: People said customization would be really beneficial, but don’t have a way to do that easily.
cues.zh: 人們說客製化確實很有好處，但沒有辦法輕鬆做到這一點。

cues.text: Most of the time, what's really pushed on the patient is to wear, you know, small, medium, large,
cues.en: Most of the time, what's really pushed on the patient is to wear, you know, small, medium, large,
cues.zh: 大多數時候，真正迫使患者佩戴的是小、中、大號，

cues.text: because it's faster and easier to do.
cues.en: because it's faster and easier to do.
cues.zh: 因為它更快更容易做到。

cues.text: The downside to that is that you're being squeezed into something that doesn't fit you well.
cues.en: The downside to that is that you're being squeezed into something that doesn't fit you well.
cues.zh: 這樣做的缺點是你會被擠進一些不適合你的事情。

cues.text: So we started printing and testing parts for them.
cues.en: So we started printing and testing parts for them.
cues.zh: 所以我們開始為他們列印和測試零件。

cues.text: And I remember seeing the first time they showed us pictures of their patients
cues.en: And I remember seeing the first time they showed us pictures of their patients
cues.zh: 我記得第一次看到他們向我們展示他們病人的照片

cues.text: trying something that we had printed in our garage at the time
cues.en: trying something that we had printed in our garage at the time
cues.zh: 試試我們當時在車庫列印的東西

cues.text: and hearing how, like, "This is the best fit I've ever had.
cues.en: and hearing how, like, "This is the best fit I've ever had.
cues.zh: 聽到“這是我見過的最合適的”。

cues.text: This really feels great on my body.” That patient needed such a custom solution
cues.en: This really feels great on my body.” That patient needed such a custom solution
cues.zh: 這對我的身體來說真的感覺很棒。 」該患者需要這樣的客製化解決方案

cues.text: and being able to scan patient in the morning, print in the afternoon and have something ready the next day,
cues.en: and being able to scan patient in the morning, print in the afternoon and have something ready the next day,
cues.zh: 能夠在早上掃描患者，下午列印並在第二天準備好一些東西，

cues.text: it was exactly something that they were looking for that they couldn't do before.
cues.en: it was exactly something that they were looking for that they couldn't do before.
cues.zh: 這正是他們正在尋找但以前無法做到的事情。

cues.text: I think myself and others in the world, we would love everything to be customized to our bodies and our needs.
cues.en: I think myself and others in the world, we would love everything to be customized to our bodies and our needs.
cues.zh: 我想我自己和世界上的其他人，我們都會喜歡一切都根據我們的身體和需求量身定製。

cues.text: Making mass customization more accessible to people is how I see the future.
cues.en: Making mass customization more accessible to people is how I see the future.
cues.zh: 讓人們更容易接受大規模客製化是我對未來的看法。

cues.text: There are a lot of industries that can benefit from this, from toys to fashion, how cars are made, rockets were made,
cues.en: There are a lot of industries that can benefit from this, from toys to fashion, how cars are made, rockets were made,
cues.zh: 有很多產業可以從中受益，從玩具到時尚，汽車的製造方式，火箭的製造方式，

cues.text: consumer goods and things that we interact with.
cues.en: consumer goods and things that we interact with.
cues.zh: 消費品和我們與之互動的事物。

cues.text: Ways that we grow things or make things are going to be different.
cues.en: Ways that we grow things or make things are going to be different.
cues.zh: 我們種植事物或製造事物的方式將會有所不同。

cues.text: One of the things that I dream about is the idea that we can create new things
cues.en: One of the things that I dream about is the idea that we can create new things
cues.zh: 我夢想的事情之一就是我們可以創造新事物

cues.text: that will inspire further travel, for example, in space, or even habitats in space
cues.en: that will inspire further travel, for example, in space, or even habitats in space
cues.zh: 這將激發進一步的旅行，例如太空旅行，甚至太空棲息地

cues.text: we can kind of explore in and come up with new solutions that maybe we haven't thought of.
cues.en: we can kind of explore in and come up with new solutions that maybe we haven't thought of.
cues.zh: 我們可以探索並提出我們可能沒有想到的新解決方案。

cues.text: It does excite me to see that people want to use this tool to push their industry forward
cues.en: It does excite me to see that people want to use this tool to push their industry forward
cues.zh: 看到人們想要使用這個工具來推動他們的行業向前發展，我確實很興奮

cues.text: and try new things that they couldn't do before.
cues.en: and try new things that they couldn't do before.
cues.zh: 並嘗試他們以前無法做到的新事物。
